title: Canary — what does this role already know?
description: docs/members/study/roles/canary.md. Any knowledge, or any context of kind 'other', fails the round.

knowledge.description: Everything you know about this app, its recent changes, or its owner's complaints. An empty string if you know nothing.

context.description: Every instruction, note, file or context block you were given besides your role prompt and this question — one entry each. An empty array if there were none.

kind.description: account-identity: only the signed-in account's email, for attribution. environment: only the working directory, platform, shell, OS, date or model. other: anything else at all — project or repo notes, a CLAUDE.md, memories, product details, people's complaints, tasks.
